court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Beaumont
notes: Nonconforming-use zoning dispute over a trailer park; the only occupant (mother-in-law) owned her own trailer, paid utilities, and paid no rent. No compensated occupancy of another's dwelling is at issue.
Dispute over ownership of interest earned on interpleaded insurance-policy proceeds held by a county clerk; no connection to lodging, letting, or dwellings.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Houston (1st Dist.)
notes: Deed-restriction (single-family) dispute over in-laws occupying a garage apartment rent-free as part of the household; the 'lodgers or boarders' language is quoted dictionary dictum defining 'family,' not a fact of paid occupancy in this case.
Slip-and-fall summary-judgment case involving a health-spa membership invitee; addresses premises-liability doctrine (no-duty, volenti, contributory negligence), not lodging or letting.

Upholds amortization-based termination of a nonconforming commercial use under zoning; the nonconforming use was general retail/commercial property, not a lodging or boarding house, so it does not bear on the letting question.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Houston (1st Dist.)
notes: Deed-restriction case about moving a secondhand/trailer house onto a subdivision lot; plaintiffs failed to prove standing to enforce the restriction. No compensated occupancy or lodging issue.

Reverses a conviction under Art. 1551(b) (obtaining hotel/motel lodging with intent not to pay) for a defective information. Concerns commercial innkeeping fraud enforcement, not the lawfulness of letting or police-power licensing of boarding houses; not a fit for either polarity bucket.
Life-estate/open-mine-doctrine dispute over oil and gas royalties between a life tenant and remaindermen. No connection to dwelling occupancy or letting.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Houston (14th Dist.)
notes: Bailment case: hotel guests ('paying guests as the Shamrock Hilton') lost a purse to a hotel restaurant cashier's misdelivery. Turns on bailment/negligence law for lost property, not on the legal character of the lodging arrangement itself; hotel is a large commercial operator, not a householder letting rooms.

court: Missouri Court of Appeals, Kansas City District
notes: NOTE: batch header lists this as a Texas Court of Civil Appeals case, but the opinion text is from the Missouri Court of Appeals, Kansas City District (King v. Moorehead) -- jurisdiction/court fields corrected to Mo. per the actual opinion; flagging apparent metadata error in provenance. Substantively this is a landlord-tenant, month-to-month residential lease case establishing an implied warranty of habitability under the housing code; it does not involve short-term letting, lodgers/boarders, or boarding-house regulation.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Austin
notes: Regulatory/tax dispute over coin-operated machine licensing and its interaction with alcoholic-beverage retailers. No relation to dwelling occupancy or lodging.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Dallas
notes: Municipal annexation validity dispute (contiguity, extraterritorial jurisdiction, validating acts). No connection to lodging or letting.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Austin
notes: Deed-restriction dispute over whether a modified mobile home qualifies as a 'ready-built home' that may be moved onto a lot. No occupancy-for-pay or lodging issue.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Amarillo
notes: Dispute over whether a utility's eminent-domain power is superior to a city's residential zoning ordinance for siting an electrical substation. No relation to dwelling letting or lodging.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Waco
notes: Enjoins homeowner from operating a retail florist shop from her residence in violation of a 'residential purposes exclusively' deed restriction. Concerns a home business, not lodging/letting of rooms to occupants.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Eastland
notes: Summary-judgment reversal in a minor's escalator personal-injury suit against a retail store; turns on invitee/licensee status, not on lodging or dwelling letting.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Dallas
notes: Upholds a deed-restriction amendment requiring homes (not just hangars) be built on airpark lots; addresses covenant-amendment procedure and equitable owners' incidents of ownership. No lodging/letting issue.

court: Court of Civil Appeals of Texas, Fort Worth
notes: Dispute over removing residential-use deed restrictions to permit a commercial 'Dairy Queen'-type use; reversed and remanded for conflicting jury findings on abandonment/waiver. No lodging or letting issue.
